Returns true only when every condition holds.

operations.description: DualFieldRead writes the current X and Y position components into v4 and v5 respectively.
Guard on a2 being non-null; the whole position check short-circuits when a2 is zero.
Guard v4 (current X) must be strictly greater than this[72] (minimum X at this+0x120).
Guard v4 (current X) must be strictly less than this[73] (maximum X at this+0x124).
Guard v5 (current Y) must be strictly greater than this[80] (minimum Y at this+0x140).
Guard v5 (current Y) must be strictly less than this[81] (maximum Y at this+0x144).
RectangleBoundsCheck(v4, v5) performs the final rectangle containment validation.
Return the logical AND of the a2 guard, the four range guards and the RectangleBoundsCheck result; invoked by LinkedListTraversalVirtualCall (00477160).
